    outs = []
    # 4 layers × 6 parameters = 24 tensors total
    # Group by layer: tensors [0:6], [6:12], [12:18], [18:24]
    for layer_idx in range(4):
        start_idx = layer_idx * 6
        end_idx = start_idx + 6
        chunk = grads[start_idx:end_idx]
        
        # Concatenate all 6 tensors in this layer into one flat tensor
        flat = torch.cat([t.reshape(-1) for t in chunk])
        
        # Single all_reduce for the entire layer
        reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, flat)
        
        # Split back into original shapes
        offset = 0
        for t in chunk:
            n = t.numel()
            outs.append(reduced[offset:offset + n].view(t.shape))
            offset += n
